phi_confirmation.title: PHI check (required)
phi_confirmation.description: Data from before skull-stripping must never be real patient data on Cirro. Select to confirm.
enum: I confirm the input contains NO PHI: it is de-identified, face-free test data (not real patient images)

organized_dataset.title: Organized DICOM dataset
organized_dataset.description: The 'astril - Organize DICOM' dataset the selected conversion plan was generated from.

edited_plan_dataset.title: Edited conversion plan (optional)
edited_plan_dataset.description: Leave blank to convert using the input dataset's plan as-is. To use a hand-edited plan instead, upload it (type 'Tables (TSV/CSV)' or 'Files', exactly one .csv) and select it here. Edit rows/selections only -- keep the folder/path columns unchanged so they can be re-pointed at this run's copies.

stop_after.title: Stop after
stop_after.description: Every stage from this pipeline's starting point runs in one go, through quantification by default. Stop earlier to review or edit an intermediate result (e.g. the conversion plan, or masks before quantifying), then continue from that dataset with the matching 'Run from ...' pipeline.

convert_n_workers.title: Convert: parallel workers
convert_n_workers.description: Leave blank to use the task's allocated CPU count (recommended); set only to override.

prior_preprocessed_dataset.title: Preprocess: prior preprocessed library (optional, test data only)
prior_preprocessed_dataset.description: Leave blank for a first-time run. To add new exams to an existing library without changing any patient's reference space, select the dataset of an earlier run that preprocessed it (its coreg log pins each patient's reference), AND select the earlier NIfTI inputs that library was built from below -- every exam is re-preprocessed together. NIfTI is PHI for real patients, so incremental preprocessing of real data is done locally.

prior_nifti_pipeline_datasets.title: Preprocess: earlier NIfTI from astril-nf runs (with a prior library)
prior_nifti_pipeline_datasets.description: Datasets of earlier astril-nf runs whose converted NIfTI (01b-convert/nifti_out) the prior library was built from.

prior_nifti_upload_datasets.title: Preprocess: earlier NIfTI uploads (with a prior library)
prior_nifti_upload_datasets.description: Uploaded NIfTI datasets ({patient}/{exam}/... at the top level) the prior library was built from.

preprocess_n_workers.title: Preprocess: parallel workers
preprocess_n_workers.description: Exam-level parallelism within this run. Also sets the compute request: this many CPUs, and this many x 'Memory per worker' GB, unless 'Total memory override' is set. The default (14 workers x 4 GB = 56 GB) fits a g5.4xlarge (16 vCPU / 64 GiB); going above that moves the task to a larger, more expensive instance.

preprocess_memory_gb_per_worker.title: Preprocess: memory per worker (GB)
preprocess_memory_gb_per_worker.description: astril doesn't budget memory itself -- this is a starting heuristic, not a measured figure. Tune against your own data if runs OOM-kill (exit 137) or over-provision.

preprocess_memory_gb.title: Preprocess: total memory override (GB)
preprocess_memory_gb.description: Leave blank to auto-compute as parallel workers x memory per worker. If set too low for the worker count, a warning is logged before the run starts.

anchor_label.title: Preprocess: anchor modality
anchor_label.description: Modality co-registration and skull-stripping are anchored to.

enable_tta.title: Preprocess: enable HD-BET test-time augmentation
enable_tta.description: Improves mask quality; recommended when GPU is available.

model_dataset.title: Segment: custom model (optional)
model_dataset.description: Leave blank to use 'Model family' below. To run a self-trained model not published through astril's model manifest, upload its directory (its pipeline.json plus checkpoints) as a 'Files' dataset and select it here -- it then takes precedence over 'Model family'.

model_family.title: Segment: model family
model_family.description: A model family registered in astril's models.json. Ignored if a custom model is selected above. This dropdown is a static list, not a live registry lookup -- add a new family here by hand when one is added to astril's models.json.

seg_filename_pattern.title: Segmentation filename pattern
seg_filename_pattern.description: Suffix segmentation writes, and quantify looks for.

labels_json_dataset.title: Quantify: labels contract (optional)
labels_json_dataset.description: Rarely needed: masks produced by this pipeline's segmentation carry their labels in a segmentation_provenance.json sidecar. Needed only for masks without one (e.g. produced elsewhere) when 'Number of segmentation levels' isn't set: upload a labels.json ({"labels": {"1": "...", ...}}) as a 'Files' dataset (exactly one .json) and select it here.

quantify_n_threads.title: Quantify: threads
quantify_n_threads.description: File I/O parallelism across the whole run. Leave blank to use the task's allocated CPU count (recommended); set only to override.

form.description: PHI WARNING: this pipeline starts from data BEFORE skull-stripping (DICOM or whole-head NIfTI). Real patient data at this point contains PHI -- DICOM headers, and identifiable faces in the image data itself -- and must NOT be uploaded to Cirro. Use these entry points only with de-identified, face-free test data. For real patients, run stages up to preprocessing locally (see the astril-nf README), upload the face-free 02-preprocess/upload_preprocessed/ folder, and start at 'astril - Run from preprocessed images'.
